content.short: ASCN is a personal AI assistant for analysis.
content.description: ASCN is a crypto AI platform built by the team behind ArbitrageScanner.io. It enables rapid scanning of both DEX and CEX markets to detect new tokens with growing liquidity, social buzz, and on-chain activity. Users can create AI assistants that answer questions, explain tokenomics, and guide users through dApps without writing code. It automatically analyzes token contracts, founder wallets, and project docs to generate summaries and investment insights. Designed specifically for Web3 tasks, ASCN is fast, affordable, and easy to integrate into crypto products.
